messages.content: Find a pet-friendly train station in Miami

function.name: find_hotel
function.description: Search for hotels based on specific criteria like price range and pet policy. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city where you want to book the hotel.

max_price_per_night.description: The maximum amount you are willing to pay per night. This is a float type value.

pet_friendly.description: Whether the hotel should allow pets. Defaults to false.

message.content:
**Miami Intermodal Center – Pet‑Friendly Train Station** | Feature | Details | |---------|---------| | **Location** | 1 SE 1st Ave, Miami, FL 33131 | | **Phone** | (305) 284‑4000 | | **Website** | [miamiintermodalcenter.com](https://miamiintermodalcenter.com) | | **Train Services** | • Amtrak Silver Service (Silver Meteor & Silver Star)
• Florida East Coast Railway (Freight & occasional passenger services) | | **Pet Policy** | • Pets are allowed in the station’s public areas (e.g., waiting rooms, concourses).
• On Amtrak trains, pets are permitted in a carrier that fits under the seat or in the luggage area.
• For Florida East Coast Railway freight trains, pets are not allowed on board, but the station itself is pet‑friendly. | | **Amenities for Pets** | • Designated “pet relief” area near the entrance (check signage).
• Accessible elevators and ramps for strollers or carriers.
• Nearby cafés and shops that allow leashed pets. | | **Accessibility** | • ADA‑compliant entrances, elevators, and signage.
• Clear pathways for walking pets or carriers. | | **Nearby Parking** | • Paid parking lots adjacent to the station; some allow pets.
• Street parking available (check local regulations). | ### Why It’s Pet‑Friendly - **Open Public Spaces:** The Intermodal Center’s concourse and waiting areas are open to pets, so you can walk your dog or cat around while you wait for your train. - **Amtrak Pet Rules:** Amtrak’s policy allows small pets in carriers on board, so you can travel with your furry friend to most destinations served by the Silver Service. - **Convenient Amenities:** The station’s proximity to pet‑friendly cafés and the nearby “pet relief” area makes it easy to manage your pet’s needs before boarding. ### Quick Tips 1. **Check Amtrak’s Pet Policy** before you travel: carriers must be no larger than 18 in. × 14 in. × 8 in. (45 cm × 35 cm × 20 cm) and must fit under the seat or in the luggage area. 2. **Arrive Early** to give yourself time to walk your pet around the station and find a comfortable spot. 3. **Keep Your Pet Leashed** in public areas to comply with local regulations and ensure safety. If you’re looking for a different train station in Miami, the **Miami Central Station** (Florida East Coast Railway) is another option, but it does not have the same level of public pet accommodations as the Intermodal Center. Enjoy your trip, and safe travels with your pet!
